title: Change of Address - Address Proof Requirement
text: To update the mailing address for your HDFC Bank credit card, please submit a self-attested scanned copy of your address proof along with your request.

title: Change of Address - Single Card Application
text: The updated Address will be recorded only for the Credit Card# as mentioned in your request. A separate application for address change to be submitted for other accounts or products with HDFC Bank (including other HDFC Bank credit card # if any).

title: Change of Address - SMS Status Notification
text: You will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number for the mentioned Credit Card#, as status information, once the Address change is updated in the credit card account or in the event we are unable to process your request.

title: Change of Address - Deliverables During Processing
text: While your address change request is under process, deliverables requested, if any, will be sent to existing address as per bank's records.

title: Acceptable Document - Aadhaar Card
text: Aadhaar Card (front & back copy, mask the first 8 digits) OR E-Aadhaar (downloaded within last 180 days, mask first 8 digits).

title: Acceptable Document - Passport
text: Passport (1st page & last page with address).

title: Acceptable Document - NREGA Job Card
text: Job card issued by NREGA duly signed by an officer of the STATE Government.

title: Acceptable Document - National Population Register Letter
text: Letter issued by National Population Register containing name and address.

title: Acceptable Document - OCI Card (NRI Customers)
text: Photocopy of overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card mentioning the overseas address (For NRI Customers Only).

title: Acceptable Document - Foreign Government Issued Documents
text: Documents issued by Govt of Foreign Jurisdiction - OCI/PIO Card, Work Resident Permit/Social Security Card/Green Card etc (Only for Foreign Citizen holding PIO/OCI card).
